settings.coachPushHelp: Choose the reminders that help you. You decide when to act on them.
settings.coachPushScope: The daily limit and pause apply to workout, missed-workout and food-log reminders across all your devices.
settings.coachPushPrivacy: Reminder text may appear on your lock screen. It won’t include private messages, food details or health measurements.
settings.coachPushAiHelp: The training assistant can write reminder text when your AI consent and sharing settings allow it. Otherwise, we use standard text.
settings.coachPushWorkoutHelp: A reminder on planned training days, using your reminder-time settings.
settings.coachPushMissedHelp: A gentle reminder the following day if a planned workout is still unlogged.
settings.coachPushFoodHelp: One reminder at {{time}} if no food has been logged that day. Off by default.
settings.coachPushFoodNeedsNutrition: Turn on nutrition features to use food-log reminders.
settings.coachPushDailyCapHelp: Choose the maximum number of coach reminders per day. You may receive fewer.
settings.coachPushQuietHelp: No push notifications during this time, except rest-timer alerts and test notifications you request. Set the same start and end time to turn quiet hours off.
settings.coachPushSnoozeHelp: Pause coach reminders on all your devices. Your other notification settings stay unchanged.
settings.coachPushSnoozeFailed: Couldn’t pause reminders. Please try again.
settings.coachPushResumed: Your selected coach reminders are active again.
settings.coachPushResumeFailed: Couldn’t resume reminders. Please try again.
settings.coachPushActive: Your selected coach reminders are active.
settings.coachPushDeviceOff: Push notifications are off on this device. Your choices still apply to other enabled devices.
settings.coachPushLoadFailed: Couldn’t load your reminder settings. Please try again.
settings.coachPushOffline: You’re offline. Connect to change reminder settings or pause reminders. Your last saved settings still apply.
settings.coachPushUnavailable: Coach notification settings aren’t available right now. Please try again later.
settings.coachPushUpdatedElsewhere: Your reminder settings changed on another device. The latest settings have been loaded.
validation.coachPushTime: Enter a valid time between 00:00 and 23:59.
push.coachWorkout.title: Hard Earned
push.coachWorkout.body: When it suits you, open Today to see your workout.
push.coachMissed.title: Hard Earned
push.coachMissed.body: Plans change. Open Today and choose what works for you.
push.coachFood.title: Hard Earned
push.coachFood.body: Want to update your food log? Do it whenever it suits you.
